description: The launcher's cold run of the prebuilt-install flow: an empty home folder holding only the player's PAL disc image (in Downloads) and the launcher's settings file naming a local release server; the window's own buttons go through the four setup steps; the release zip is downloaded, checked against SHA256SUMS and placed; Play reaches the title state in the launcher's play log. Zero commands typed.
ps2r_ini_must_set_why: 2026-10-27: the new folder's ps2r.ini names the two language rows (game.text_language, game.speech_language) in place of game.language

launcher_update.games_line: A new launcher is ready: v9.9.9. This copy of the launcher cannot replace itself. Download the new one from its page.
launcher_update.about_line: A new launcher is ready: v9.9.9. This copy of the launcher cannot replace itself. Download the new one from its page.

launcher_update_why: 2026-10-28: the list also names a newer launcher (v9.9.9, published after the driver was made); the driver is no launcher installed from a release, so the offer says it cannot replace itself and gives the release's page, without downloading the file
